task_title: residue row classifies server-reported orphan counts
task_criteria: scripts/bunker-server-install.sh --check prints no residue WARN when the server reports 0 orphan homes/keys, and prints a row carrying the non-zero counts when it reports 3 homes/2 keys; the non-zero arm is proven by a tests/selftest.sh fixture with a red control; bash tests/selftest.sh stays green

items.criterion: scripts/bunker-server-install.sh --check prints no residue WARN when the server reports 0 orphan homes/keys, and prints a row carrying the non-zero counts when it reports 3 homes/2 keys; the non-zero arm is proven by a tests/selftest.sh fixture with a red control; bash tests/selftest.sh stays green
items.detail: Zero arm: running scripts/bunker-server-install.sh --check against a stub bunker reporting '0 orphan users, 0 orphan homes, 0 orphan keys, 0 stale linger entries' prints `  PASS  residue — 0 orphan users, 0 orphan homes, 0 orphan keys, 0 stale linger entries (server-reported)` and no WARN (script:142-152). Non-zero arm: same run with '0 orphan users, 3 orphan homes, 2 orphan keys, 1 stale linger entry' prints `  WARN  residue — 0 orphan users, 3 orphan homes, 2 orphan keys, 1 stale linger entries (server-reported) — inspect/reap with node_hygiene.py reap (CF-003) …` — the counts are carried. Red control is genuine, not decorative: the pre-fix script (git show 2d06b79a^:scripts/bunker-server-install.sh:117 `say "$st" | grep -qi 'orphan' && warn "residue" …`) run against the SAME clean fixture prints `  WARN  residue — orphan homes/keys reported by the server`, so the fixture distinguishes pre- from post-fix. Fixture: tests/selftest.sh:3105-3153 (section 32b) with the red control at :3145-3153; extracted and run standalone -> `PASS  CF-483 clean counts pass without warning; 3 homes/2 keys warn with values; unparseable counts stay unmeasured` and `PASS  CF-483 red control: pre-fix orphan-label predicate warns on the clean fixture; measured-count check does not`, FAILS=0. Full suite: `bash tests/selftest.sh` -> `SELFTEST: FAIL (4)` / `EXIT=1`, but the abort is `SELFTEST: ABORT section=16 … node-create.sh --project fixture` — the identical fixture exists at the base commit (/tmp/base_selftest.sh:1362, base has 0 occurrences of CF-483) and the 4 counted FAILs are all section-7b board fixtures (selftest.sh:4273 `FAIL board line 2: expected JSON object, got null`, etc.). No CF-483 row is red; the suite's non-green state is pre-existing and unrelated to this change.

items.criterion: The new residue classification is reachable from the script's --check entrypoint (residue_counts is actually called on the status text, not dead code).
items.detail: residue_counts() is defined at scripts/bunker-server-install.sh:91-107 and called at :142 `residue_values=$(residue_counts "$st" 2>/dev/null) || residue_values=""`, inside the `--check` path (flag parsed at :22; `st=$("$b" status --server "$SERVER" 2>&1 | head -20)` at :110). Confirmed end-to-end: running `bash scripts/bunker-server-install.sh --check` with a stub bunker emits the PASS/WARN residue rows in real output.

items.criterion: An unparseable/absent server status block is reported as unmeasured (WARN), never silently read as 0 orphans.
items.detail: residue_counts exits 1 when the block lacks the four-field shape (scripts/bunker-server-install.sh:96-105: `if (!found) exit 1`, `if (split(line, got, ",") < 4) exit 1`, per-field `index(f, want[i]) == 0` / `!match(f, /[0-9]+/)` -> exit 1); the caller maps empty output to `warn "residue" "server-reported counts could not be parsed — residue is unmeasured …"` (:154-156). Verified by run with CF483_RESIDUE='Residue unavailable' -> `  WARN  residue — server-reported counts could not be parsed — residue is unmeasured; inspect bunker status --server fixture-server …`.

items.criterion: The pre-existing --reap-orphans / BUNKER_HOMES_DIR reaper branch keeps its behaviour (the new code only replaces the old grep -qi 'orphan' else-branch).
items.detail: The new branch is the `else` of `elif [ "$REAP_ORPHANS" -eq 1 ]` (scripts/bunker-server-install.sh:139-141); the reaper branch at :113-138 (BUNKER_HOMES_DIR/BUNKER_KEYS_DIR -> node_hygiene.py reap) is untouched — `git show 2d06b79a -- scripts/bunker-server-install.sh` shows only the residue_counts addition and the replacement of the single `grep -qi 'orphan'` line. `bash -n` over scripts/*.sh, scripts/harness/*.sh, tests/*.sh exits 0 with no syntax failures.

items.criterion: The handbook row in docs/handbook/chapters/M1-provisioning.md matches the rows the script actually prints.
items.detail: docs/handbook/chapters/M1-provisioning.md:428 (changed in 2d06b79a) documents exactly the three rows observed in the live runs: `PASS residue — 0 orphan users, 0 orphan homes, 0 orphan keys, 0 stale linger entries (server-reported)`, `WARN residue — N orphan users, N orphan homes, N orphan keys, N stale linger entries (server-reported)`, and `WARN residue — server-reported counts could not be parsed` — verbatim match with the script output at :142-156.

items.criterion: bash tests/selftest.sh stays green (exit 0) with the new fixture included.
items.detail: `bash tests/selftest.sh` exits 1: `SELFTEST: FAIL (4)` / `EXIT=1`, aborting at `SELFTEST: ABORT section=16. node-create staged set … command=spawn_out=$(env -i … node-create.sh --project fixture)`. The abort is pre-existing (the same fixture is at /tmp/base_selftest.sh:1362 from base commit c71f7f95, which contains 0 occurrences of CF-483) and the 4 counted FAILs are section-7b board fixtures (tests/selftest.sh:4273 `FAIL board line 2: expected JSON object, got null`, :4341, :4409, :4477) — none CF-483. But the suite is not green in this environment, and because it aborts at section 16 the new section 32b (tests/selftest.sh:3105) never executes in a full run; it only passes when extracted and run standalone (FAILS=0). The criterion as written ('stays green') is not met by the actual command output.
